bio: Dating back to 1497, this historical townhouse in Zug's old town is a lovely location. The friendly service and relaxed atmosphere here are appreciated by locals and tourists alike. Diners can choose from the selection of classics such as cordon bleu, Lammhacktätschli (lamb patties) and beef roulades, and there is also a seasonal menu. The tables on the gorgeous terrace in front of the building in the cobbled pedestrian area are coveted. Tip: Just a stone's throw away, the lakeside is perfect for a stroll....
